You can migrate your ChatGPT history and memory to Claude using `direct data export or Claude's built-in memory import tool`.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kTL5-cN-UDc&t=36)

### Method 1: Use Claude's Memory Import Tool

1. In Claude, go to **Settings** > **Capabilities** and click **Start Import** (or visit `claude.com/importmemory`).
2. Copy the migration prompt provided by Claude.
3. Paste and run the prompt inside ChatGPT to pull your stored memories, custom instructions, identity, and preference summary into a single code block.
4. Review and clean up the generated output to remove outdated info, then paste it back into Claude's **Add to Memory** section.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESvAEBxCJF11DWlfOMJwMSxjGwC3g_F2hVCU_P2zNKUF7GEU8dcaSUSlGYdwnovlL9mhB1SPyfQHffhvJgtqUx6IXiuveBraclh6t5zJMnNZBGOm18RKQr7xUwRc2dze-w87bhwsE4QRjDOIspT52kq8UFTbvOq04ozRjUrJDrNTieZUCGNguuPB9YWHH-He4QJ_xcork97WuGwJ7w1VMnmVdeTWhOrsHdQSUwPqF-yUs6rXEEfm7H6gTjWrtxng)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=96fX_1KXYRw&t=27)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/947tzOR-yo8)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/IaWv0c7gjSg)

### Method 2: Export Full Chat History via Data Controls

1. In ChatGPT, go to **Settings** > **Data Controls** > **Export Data** and confirm.
2. Wait for OpenAI to email you the export ZIP file (this can take anywhere from a few hours up to 48 hours).
3. Download and unzip the folder to locate your `chat.html` or `conversations.json` file.
4. Move the files into Claude by either creating a new **Claude Project** and uploading the export file as knowledge, or using Claude Desktop's Cowork feature to read the local export directory directly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1xFKNHvO-rfEr6gZ9c-R5iTV07ZiGkO7fKIE_mkPj4Jk3uOy5Eilj4QWfwISvfYn-CWGzmBgpv0_2Guwoe8IzkeZJAm4m-BnBStjDQiEbI0sEetTP87D9XuNt6ARDfYpiJxBwqSfix54QVm3xNjkYEIMy_cpAZZoU_NIHD0gj1SAftQjX86ZWxrEla4qJhWLy3BDN0SfYNgtbCJe)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXfffkf-aMQH9Cy7tBUIltygbQ9apYWb7OjF4LHpaQ3SLlesIH2Lwz5s-JjhWBSmUOOlmqIpHNTVtEelW1RgwLv5Fo8febQrO5KlJ8MMgNccI6oRcJuTSHaD_LGjj2Srn7zbzQSYBWUA)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/LP2N0tmPKoI)
